split_policy.primary_axis: e2e fixture role before fixture path convenience, exit-code sidecar, conformance manifest row, package-stage pointer, generated report pointer, or retired-surface tag
split_policy.positive_rule: e2e positives are hand-authored tests/native/e2e fixtures with fixture_kind=positive, canonical_behavior_source=true, and retired_positive_surface=false
split_policy.strict_error_rule: negative execution, legacy literal rejection, and runtime dispatch misses are rejection or strict-error evidence; they are not positive runnable support
split_policy.docs_evidence_rule: owner index rows, phase contracts, module-roundtrip manifests, example manifests, package-stage pointers, report pointers, and metadata field names are provenance unless tied to an e2e fixture sidecar
split_policy.rejection_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, generated-only, report-only, and migration-only e2e rows are rejection or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.omitted_phase_rule: this family has no parser, sema, lowering, IR, or runtime behavior contracts
